_about: Hand-graded accuracy of scripts/out/lanes.py on random samples of 100 upcoming events from data/events/events.json (generated 2026-10-29T12:24). Graded by the builder (Claude) reading title, venue, time, category, price and description. Precision = tags given that were right; recall = right tags out of all tags that should have been given. Small lanes (open-mic, gallery, civic, sports-watch) are too rare for a 100-event sample, so every member of those lanes was reviewed by hand instead.

known_limits: Sports-watch only sees games that are in the events feed (UVM's campus calendar posts few); data/out/sports.json carries the full UVM and high school home schedules and the app should union the two.
About 4 in 100 events carry a wrong indoor/outdoor flag from the source (Seven Days); the outdoors lane trusts it.
611 of 2,568 events get no lane (language groups, lectures, yoga classes, bridge); that is expected, not a miss.
